name: fleet-steward
description: claude-fleet steward: /fleet-steward opens a steward session (the steward agent file, bound to no issue) that keeps watch on its own /loop — answers what a batch charter already says, spawns a red base's fixer, lands a green batch nobody drives; closing it ends the watch. Its old panes still ship until EPIC #4333 C6 removes them. Not installed by default (EPIC #3111).
